digest.component_or_area: MCP adapter for ticket linking operations
propositions: MCP unlink_tickets adapter omits the relation parameter from both its registered FastMCP callable signature and its rebar.unlink delegate call, preventing relation-specific edge removal.
The live MCP schema advertises only id1 and id2 parameters, making the already-supported relation selector unexpressable to MCP clients.

When unlink_tickets receives a ticket pair with multiple relations and no explicit relation selector, it removes the most-recent edge instead of the requested one due to pair-scoped fallback behavior.
The library, CLI, and intended MCP contract require total parameter parity for unlink with optional relation support, but MCP currently diverges from this ruling.

Adding relation: str | None = None to the callable signature and forwarding it unchanged to rebar.unlink restores parity and enables explicit relation-scoped removal while preserving pair-scoped fallback when omitted.
